BUILT FOR INSIDE THE GAME
The brief. The build. The proof.
01 / REAL-TIME INTELLIGENCE
Follow a full match as it unfolds.
Seeded events stream from Azure. Statistics update between AI checkpoints; a full-time recap follows the final whistle.
02 / STORIES & HIGHLIGHTS
Three voices. Replayable evidence.
Scout observes, Check challenges, Host explains. Public contributions link to reviewed moments in the generated film.
03 / EXPLAINABILITY
A claim must survive a correction.
Change one tracking record. See a movement claim withdrawn while unaffected statistics remain intact.
04 / DATA INNOVATION
Take the synthetic data with you.
Export completed events, fictional player metadata, sampled tracking, provenance and a versioned screen cue.
05 / GLOBAL & PERSONAL
More than a translated headline.
Compare beginner, math and tactical explanations in English, Spanish and Portuguese. Watch adds fan and player modes.
06 / STUDIO & STREAMING
Intelligence with an output contract.
Timed cues include an audience, evidence references and expiry. The live demo exports its own AI-backed match package.
RUNNING ON EXISTING AZURE SERVICESAzure OpenAIContainer AppsBlob StorageManaged identity
WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT
A story you can question.
Visible editorial handoffs, an evidence cutoff, and corrections that change the output. New fans get plain language; curious fans get the calculation.
WHAT IS STILL TO BUILD
Clear limits. Credible demo.
Automatic video event detection, inferred player tagging, calibrated pass difficulty and a broadcast-partner connection are not implemented. The film, tactical scenarios and full-match generator are separate sources. Fabric integration is not claimed.
